notes: `כָּהֵם` → *even so* is kept as one indivisible rendering; the competing reading gives *even* to the pronoun and *so* to the preposition, which no subtraction test supports.
`כְּשֶׁ` → *when* fuses under rule 30 rather than leaving the relative `unrepresented` (rule 22's closing paragraph).
The article on `אֲחֻזוֹת` takes the relative *that* under rule 41, while the article on `הָאָדָם` takes the fronted *the* of *the sons of men* under rule 29.
